map.不能。生存概率是0到1之间的累积概率，由逐年生存概率连乘得到；若算得大于1 说明: No. Survival probability is a cumulative probability between 0 and 1, from multiplying yearly survival probabilities; if it exceeds 1, some year's survivors exceed the start-of-year count, a data error to verify.
map.t 年生存概率（本页代码口径）：ₜpₓ=lₓ₊ₜ÷lₓ；联动量：死亡概率=1−ₜ: t-year survival probability (code basis on this page): ₜpₓ = lₓ₊ₜ ÷ lₓ; linked values: death probability = 1 − ₜpₓ, survivors per thousand = ₜpₓ × 1000, log survival rate = ln(max(ₜpₓ, 10⁻¹²)). Validation: both fields are required and must be valid numbers, otherwise it prompts and stops. Rule: no fixed grading; for ₜpₓ in [0,1] the death probability is complementary and the log term is always non-positive.
